name: openspec-propose
title_zh: 需求说一句，设计规格任务三件套一起交
tagline_zh: 你只说了想做什么，它就把设计文档、能力规格、可执行任务清单一次性铺好，省掉来回追问和手工补文档的半天。
tagline_en: Say what you want to build; it lays out design doc, capability specs and an actionable task list in one pass.
desc_en: Propose a new change with all artifacts generated in one step. Use when the user wants to quickly describe what they want to build and get a complete proposal with design, specs, and tasks ready for implementation.
why_zh: 不是逐条问你，而是先按 OpenSpec 的固定结构把提案写全，你只在成品上改，而不是从空白页开始。
why_en: It doesn't interrogate you step by step — it drafts the full OpenSpec proposal first, so you edit instead of starting blank.
limit_zh: 只产出提案阶段的文档，不写实现代码、不跑测试；项目里得已有 OpenSpec 目录结构，否则它生成的规格无处安放。
limit_en: Proposal-stage docs only: no implementation code, no tests. Requires an existing OpenSpec directory, or the generated specs have nowhere to land.
title_en: One sentence in, design + specs + tasks out
